subject: Input devices exposed by the VirtualBuddy 2.1 generic EFI profile
host_configuration_source: vm/virtualbuddy_probe.swift (accepted probe) and vm/virtualbuddy_console_probe.swift use identical device configuration

devices.guest_presentation: USB HID keyboard behind the implicit USB controller; no explicit USB controller is configured by the host profile
devices.guest_driver_status: unsupported: the published PureDarwin source has no XHCI or HID keyboard driver for this platform
unsupported: no XHCI or HID driver
devices.decision: inventoried, not selected; the text console does not consume pointer input

devices.guest_presentation: virtio multiport console device (virtio device id 0x1043 feature bit 1)
devices.guest_driver_status: deliberately skipped by the loader (single-port console only)

devices.guest_presentation: single-port virtio console; port 0 queue 1 is the accepted TX path, queue 0 is the RX input path
devices.guest_driver_status: TX accepted since the platform checkpoint; RX implemented by vm/patches/xnu-loader-virtualbuddy-console-input.patch and vm/patches/puredarwin-virtualbuddy-console-input.patch
devices.decision: SELECTED supported virtual input profile: the backend supplies input bytes through the attachment's read file handle; vm/virtualbuddy_console_probe.swift attaches a host FIFO (console-input.fifo) and scripts/vm/console_input.py writes validated frames

guest_input_path: RX virtqueue -> pe_serial rd0/rr0 -> serial_keyboard_poll (16 ms) -> cons_cinput -> console tty line discipline -> /dev/console; Ctrl-C (0x03) and Ctrl-D EOF (0x04) are interpreted by the existing tty line discipline, not by the driver
no_proprietary_runtime: input path uses only public Virtualization.framework attachments and source-built guest code
